Maria: FYI marking Forsythe as at-risk — usage down 42% last 30d, procurement paused, competitor pilot started. Need triage.
Evan: On it. Had a call w/ their VP Product yesterday. They asked about Private deployment POC and pricing. Who can own technical onboarding?
Ravi: I can run numbers for Private vs Hosted. Quick check — drop seems embedding-heavy, batch jobs backoff. I'll pull logs.
Samir: Noted. I'll own the onboarding checklist + SF update. We should propose Dedicated pool 30d trial. @Maria want me to draft the SOW?
Maria: Yes please. Assign Evan as exec owner, Samir onboarding, Ravi pricing. @eng-ops-bot pull 90d token + endpoint breakdown for Forsythe.
eng-ops-bot: Query complete — embeddings tokens down 78% since 2026-02-28. Top callers: jobs-runner, analytics-ingest. Raw: https://internal.metrics/forsythe
Evan: Competitor pitched lower per-embedding cost via aggressive quantization. @Ravi can you run cost sim: hosted + quantized v dedicated pool?
Ravi: Will do. Quick calc:
```
Hosted baseline: $0.0009/embedding
Quantized sim (4-bit): ~$0.0005 => ~44% savings
Dedicated estimate: ~$0.00035 (w/ committed capacity)
```
Need approval on offering discount bands for 3mo POC.
Samir: For POC infra they asked for VPC + KMS. We have a new private-deploy checklist: https://docs.internal/private-quickstart
Evan: I'll send calendar invite for POC scoping Fri 9am PT and include Procurement + CTO. Maria — can you prep a short one-pager on risk + suggested ask (SOW + pricing)?
Maria: Will draft and share by EOD tomorrow. Also request a prompt set and eval plan from their PM to track quality vs competitor.
Samir: I'll prep onboarding runbook and a one-click checklist for the first-week tasks.
Ravi: Added pricing scenarios to the shared doc. Tagging @Maria for final approval before sending.
Maria: Thanks — team, aim to have customer-facing packet + POC plan by next Tue. I'll ping legal for a standard POC SOW. :thumbsup:
Evan: sounds good. I'll update SF with next steps.
eng-ops-bot: Reminder — scheduled data pull for Forsythe on 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC.
